estimate.damage_summary: A mains overvoltage during a thunderstorm damaged a TV and speaker system. A technician subsequently checked the surge failure and wiring; no surge-protective device was used.
estimate.policy_notes: Overvoltage damage to appliances is covered subject to the EUR 5,000 aggregate appliance sub-limit and the pre-loss-standard restriction. Because the description establishes that no surge-protective device was used, the indemnity for the affected appliances is halved. Technician diagnosis and attendance are not indemnifiable repair costs on these facts.

lines.invoice_text: Surge-damaged home electronics (speaker system and TV set)
lines.rationale: The two appliances are plausibly the physically damaged electronics described, and the photo supports damage to the TV and audio equipment. The unit estimate allows for equivalent standard-grade replacements without an upgrade; the policy halves otherwise payable indemnity because no surge protector was used.

lines.invoice_text: Diagnostic surge-failure report and technician call-out
lines.rationale: The diagnostic visit relates to the reported event, but inspection, reporting and attendance alone are not a repair cost or an insured cost head under the stated policy terms. Even assuming validity, one report/attendance is plausible; three units are not supported.
